name: Rebirth
placementTarget: On an Infection card, in its white improvement panel. The sticker says "this card will not infect" and does not print a separate placement line.
summary: Rebirth. If the city is recovering, meaning its population is 6 or more, this Infection card does not infect it. Do not remove a Supply cube and do not place a Plague cube. Hollow Men Gather still takes effect. No code is printed on this scan. The component list prices each copy at 1 production unit.

mechanics.timing: When this Infection card would infect its city. Bought at game end with production units. The 1-unit price is the catalog description of the sticker, not a numeral printed on this image.
mechanics.effect: If the city has a population of 6 or more, the card does not infect that city. Skip removing a Supply cube and skip placing a Plague cube. A Hollow Men Gather draw still adds its figure when this card is the city that draw reveals.
restrictions: The recovering test is population 6 or more, printed on the sticker.
The skip covers the normal infect step only. Hollow Men Gather still places a figure.
No P3 code is visible on the sticker image.
